why: None of the major reviewers here (TechRadar three times, Tom's Guide) answer the HYROX question. Their pages are general guides to fitness trackers, smartwatches and running watches, so they only answer a neighbouring question. The pages that do answer it are niche HYROX sites. RoxSkin is the strongest: it compares race modes by brand and gives budget picks, but it relies on cited sources rather than its own testing. The rest are affiliate roundups, and two returned no text. A focused budget HYROX page with current prices and race-mode checks would stand out.
